svg.aria-label: PlacebAIStudio, featured, private repository with a live demo: Every effect works, except none of them touch your audio. Reverb echoes your clicks, bass boost drops the buttons, and export hands back a silent master. Champion, Rage Quit Award at MALFUNCTION Hackathon 2026, iDE.A iAcademy. Built with React, TypeScript, Vite, Vitest, Matter.js, XState, Claude API.
